description: Semantic abstraction of NSL-KDD features observed in real SHAP explanations.

count.definition: Number of connections to the same destination host as the current connection during the previous two seconds.
count.soc_interpretation: Measures the recent concentration of connections toward the same destination.

srv_count.definition: Number of connections to the same service as the current connection during the previous two seconds.
srv_count.soc_interpretation: Measures the recent concentration of connections toward the same network service.

dst_host_rerror_rate.definition: Proportion of historical connections to the same destination host that contain rejection errors.
dst_host_rerror_rate.soc_interpretation: Represents repeated rejected connection attempts involving the destination host.

dst_host_diff_srv_rate.definition: Proportion of connections to different services among historical connections to the same destination host.
dst_host_diff_srv_rate.soc_interpretation: Measures the diversity of services contacted on the destination host.

diff_srv_rate.definition: Proportion of connections to different services among recent connections to the same destination host.
diff_srv_rate.soc_interpretation: Measures rapid variation in the services contacted on a destination.

dst_host_same_src_port_rate.definition: Proportion of historical connections to the destination host that use the same source port.
dst_host_same_src_port_rate.soc_interpretation: Provides context about source-port reuse in connections involving the destination.

logged_in.definition: Indicates whether the connection completed a successful login.
logged_in.soc_interpretation: Provides authentication context for the analyzed connection.

src_bytes.definition: Number of data bytes transferred from the source to the destination.
src_bytes.soc_interpretation: Measures the volume of data sent by the source.

dst_bytes.definition: Number of data bytes transferred from the destination to the source.
dst_bytes.soc_interpretation: Measures the volume of data received from the destination.

flag_SF.definition: One-hot encoded representation indicating whether the original connection flag is SF.
flag_SF.soc_interpretation: Indicates the presence or absence of a normally established and completed connection state.
flag_SF.source: Derived from the one-hot encoding of the KDD connection flag

protocol_type_icmp.definition: Indicates whether the analyzed connection uses the ICMP protocol.
protocol_type_icmp.soc_interpretation: Provides protocol context associated with ICMP traffic, which may be used during host discovery when combined with other evidence.
protocol_type_icmp.source: Derived from the one-hot encoding of the NSL-KDD protocol_type feature

service_eco_i.definition: Indicates whether the connection uses the eco_i service associated with ICMP echo traffic.
service_eco_i.soc_interpretation: Represents ICMP echo activity that may contribute to evidence of host discovery when supported by additional observations.
service_eco_i.source: Derived from the one-hot encoding of the NSL-KDD service feature

dst_host_srv_diff_host_rate.definition: Proportion of connections to the same service that involve different destination hosts.
dst_host_srv_diff_host_rate.soc_interpretation: Measures whether a service is contacted across multiple destination hosts, which may support evidence of distributed exploration.

dst_host_serror_rate.definition: Proportion of historical connections to the destination host that contain SYN errors.
dst_host_serror_rate.soc_interpretation: Measures unsuccessful SYN-based connection activity involving the destination host.

service_ftp_data.definition: Indicates whether the connection uses the FTP-DATA service.
service_ftp_data.soc_interpretation: Provides service context about the use or absence of an FTP data-channel connection.
service_ftp_data.source: Derived from the one-hot encoding of the NSL-KDD service feature

protocol_type_tcp.definition: Indicates whether the analyzed connection uses the TCP protocol.
protocol_type_tcp.soc_interpretation: Provides protocol context about the presence or absence of TCP traffic.
protocol_type_tcp.source: Derived from the one-hot encoding of the NSL-KDD protocol_type feature
